name: freertos-kernel
notes: Vendored Pico C++ runtime dependency used by the dual-core Pico FreeRTOS runtime. Control and service tasks both live under RTOS semantics; task affinity keeps safety-critical control isolated from transport and networking.

name: mongoose
notes: Vendored Pico C++ runtime dependency for HTTP/WebSocket transport on the FreeRTOS service task pinned to core 0.

name: microdot
notes: Pinned to the official upstream package layout so websocket support comes from microdot.websocket.
